name: celiador-remote
description: Run Claude agents on your repositories from your phone, in VS Code or Cursor: label a GitHub issue, review and merge the pull request from the Celiador iPhone app.

untrustedWorkspaces.description: Agents do not run in Restricted Mode, and workspace settings cannot change where your credentials are sent.

commands.title: Run an Agent on This Repository…

celiador.daemonUrl.description: Your Celiador server (leave empty for https://celiador.ai). Self-hosting? Point this at your own daemon.

celiador.supabaseUrl.description: Override the sign-in server the daemon announces. Leave empty.

enumDescriptions: Claude decides per tool call: routine commands run, risky ones ask you on the phone.
Every tool call asks for approval, on the phone and in the editor.
celiador.agentTasks.permissionMode.description: How much an agent run may do without asking.

celiador.agentTasks.issueComment.description: When a queued GitHub issue starts running, comment on it (with your GitHub sign-in) saying an agent picked it up. Not needed when the Celiador GitHub App is installed on the repository: it comments as Celiador.

celiador.agentTasks.attribution.description: Add a line to pull requests opened by agent runs saying they were made with Celiador.

scripts.package: npm run typecheck && npm run build && vsce package --no-dependencies
